Name: Alternate IceFox Portrait (mermaid island)
Author: Neonify
Description:
I love the mermaid island mod but the fox portrait always bothered me for some reason, he was looking a little thicc so I made him a new portrait!!
I didn't have any part in making the mermaid island mod, I have it and use it and like it but if you want to use this portrait you need to get the original mod made by hisameart along with its own requirements: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4216?tab=description]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4216?tab=description[/url]

I'm also using shie's portraits made by Shiela: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264?tab=description]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264?tab=description[/url] so I tried mimicking her style because I wanted all of the npc portraits for my save to blend in, I love her portraits and you should try them if you don't have a portrait mod and want one

If the og mod creator sees this I love your mod but I just wanted to change a small detail for myself and I figured I might as well share it lmao, let me know if you want me to remove it or anything

installation requirements:
mermaid island mod and its requirements
portraiture

download the file, unzip into a folder that you make in the portraiture mod folder, and enjoy :D
